verification.scope: exact declared producer and receipt paths
verification.note: commit_sha is null at binding time because this receipt is committed inside the commit it names. The queue card's archive block is bound to the resolved sha immediately after the commit and the verifier is run against it, with the verdict recorded on the card.

what_this_notarization_asserts: ONE THING ONLY: that the pre-registration's content EXISTS IN GIT BEFORE ANY MEASUREMENT GOVERNED BY IT. It does NOT assert that the freeze is correct, adequate, or well-designed. Those are separate properties and they are under independent audit at the time of this commit. The distinction is the reason notarizing now costs nothing: no measurement task has been dispatched, and dispatching them is a Coordinator action gated on the audit, not on this commit.
if_the_audit_finds_a_blocker: A superseding pre-registration is written as a NEW FILE IN A NEW TASK DIRECTORY and notarized in turn; this document is recorded as SUPERSEDED BEFORE USE and never governs a measurement. Records are immutable and corrections supersede rather than overwrite, so prereg.md is never edited in place and `git log --follow` on it returns exactly one commit permanently -- which is the check that closed BATCH-f19c37's notarization gap and is preserved here by construction.
no_durability_commit: One commit, exactly the three declared paths. BATCH-f19c37's producer snapshot a517e013 failed strict verification because a disclosed durability commit put three artifacts outside it; DEC-20260806-14ac13 made the fix binding and it is honoured here.
ordering: Committed BEFORE any of TASK-20260806-3084bc, -e17677 or -c973e6 is dispatched. Those three verify this notarized sha256 at start and abort on mismatch.
producer_disclosure_carried_forward: The producer declares in prereg.md section B.0 that SECTION B IS NOT BLIND: the AM-3 re-run's data is bitwise determined by committed seeds and the producer has read the report tabulating it. What Section B freezes is a RULE -- the gate, its false-failure rate, its multiplicity policy, all three computable without the data -- and NOT an outcome. No record arising from Section B may describe its verdict as an out-of-sample test. Carried here so the constraint travels with the archive.
